tagging_basis: OCR H432 numbered specification sections (lettered learning outcomes as evidence)

units.label: 1(a)(i)
units.summary: Explain what is meant by relative atomic mass of an element.

units.label: 1(a)(ii)
units.summary: Determine an unknown isotope of strontium from the relative atomic mass and other abundances.

units.label: 1(b)
units.summary: Draw a labelled metallic bonding diagram and explain strontium's high melting point and conductivity.
units.difficulty_basis: Standard diagram plus two linked explanations

units.label: 1(c)(i)
units.summary: Write the equation for strontium reacting with water.

units.label: 1(c)(ii)
units.summary: Describe two observations that would differ if calcium replaced strontium.

units.label: 1(d)(i)
units.summary: Calculate x in hydrated strontium chloride from mass data.

units.label: 1(d)(ii)
units.summary: Suggest why the crucible and residue were weighed four times.
units.difficulty_basis: Recall of heating to constant mass

units.label: 1(d)(iii)
units.summary: Suggest two modifications to reduce the percentage uncertainty in a residue mass.

units.label: 2(a)
units.summary: Describe how to prepare a standard solution of magnesium nitrate from hydrated crystals including quantities.
units.difficulty_basis: Six mark response combining calculation and detailed practical method

units.label: 2(b)
units.summary: Calculate the minimum volume of nitric acid needed to make a given mass of magnesium nitrate.
units.difficulty_basis: Three step reacting quantities with 1:2 ratio

units.label: 2(c)
units.summary: Use oxidation numbers to identify which element is oxidised and reduced in magnesium nitrate decomposition.

units.label: 3(a)(i)
units.summary: Outline the mechanism of hydrolysis of 1-iodopentane by hydroxide ions.

units.label: 3(a)(ii)
units.summary: State what to measure and observe to compare hydrolysis rates of haloalkanes.

units.label: 3(a)(iii)
units.summary: Explain why 1-iodopentane hydrolyses faster than 1-bromopentane.

units.label: 3(b)(i)
units.summary: State what the molecular ion peak at m/z 198 shows.

units.label: 3(b)(ii)
units.summary: Write structural formulae for fragment ions at m/z 71 and 43.

units.label: 3(c)(i)
units.summary: Draw the structure of 2-iodo-2-methylbutane.

units.label: 3(c)(ii)
units.summary: Suggest one similarity and one difference between mass spectra of two isomers.

units.label: 4(a)
units.summary: Calculate the volume of hydrogen from a given acid and excess zinc at RTP.
units.difficulty_basis: Three step with 1:2 ratio and molar volume

units.label: 4(b)(i)
units.summary: Label the time axis and plot gas volume results on graph paper.

units.label: 4(b)(ii)
units.summary: Circle any anomalous result on the plotted graph.

units.label: 4(b)(iii)
units.summary: Draw a smooth best-fit curve through the plotted points excluding the anomaly.

units.label: 4(c)
units.summary: Sketch the curve expected when a different acid concentration and volume is used.
units.difficulty_basis: Needs final volume reasoning and rate change

units.label: 4(d)
units.summary: Explain in terms of collision theory why the reaction rate decreases over time.

units.label: 4(e)(i)
units.summary: Explain how a catalyst increases reaction rate.
units.difficulty_basis: Activation energy and proportion of molecules

units.label: 4(e)(ii)
units.summary: Suggest why copper(II) sulfate is hard to classify as homogeneous or heterogeneous catalyst.

units.label: 5(a)(i)
units.summary: Draw the products of hex-1-ene with hydrogen, hydrogen chloride and bromine.
units.difficulty_basis: Three addition products including major product

units.label: 5(a)(ii)
units.summary: State the catalyst for hydrogenation of an alkene.

units.label: 5(a)(iii)
units.summary: State the observation when hex-1-ene reacts with bromine.

units.label: 5(b)(i)
units.summary: Calculate mass of hexan-1-ol needed using percentage yield and explain purification of hex-1-ene.
units.difficulty_basis: Six mark response combining yield calculation and separation method

units.label: 5(b)(ii)
units.summary: Predict and explain the yield of hex-1-ene from dehydrating hexan-2-ol compared with hexan-1-ol.

units.label: 5(c)(i)
units.summary: Draw a section of poly(hex-1-ene) with two repeat units.

units.label: 5(c)(ii)
units.summary: State two beneficial methods of disposing of waste polymers.
